falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% bottom_2024_aug pattern match would be broken, as that pattern saw lower lows for 3 weeks before reversal; an immediate breakout to new highs invalidates the bottom-call analog and suggests accumulation rather than distribution

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below 14 would contradict the elevated uncertainty regime typical of bottom_2024_aug, which saw VIX remain above 16 until the actual reversal; this signals complacency incompatible with a bottoming process

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern coincided with yields rising/stabilizing as growth fears peaked; a sharp flight-to-quality bid driving yields sub-3.80% would indicate a deflationary scare or recession pricing that breaks the reflation-bottom analog

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
